title: Domain Modeling with EFCore Mapping Configuration
prerequisites: Read AGENTS.md - Feature Vertical Slice Pattern section
Familiarity with C# classes, properties, and constructors
Understanding of database relationships (one-to-many, foreign keys)
Basic knowledge of Entity Framework Core concepts

inputs.description: Domain entity specification with properties, relationships, and validation rules
items: List of properties with C# types and required/optional designation
Validation rules (string lengths, numeric ranges, custom rules)
Common query patterns for performance index planning

outputs.description: Domain entity class and EF Core persistence mapper integrated with the application
items: EF Core mapper class in SlimBus.Infra/Features/<Feature>/Mappers/
Database migration script ready for deployment

successCriteria: Entity class follows class-first design with encapsulated state and mutation methods
Mapper class is sealed and auto-discoverable via Scrutor scanning
All properties correctly mapped with EF Core constraints and validation
Foreign keys and relationships configured for database integrity
Performance indexes added for common query patterns
Code compiles with zero warnings (warnings-as-errors enforced)
nonGoals: Testing the entity (see CRUD Operations Skill for business logic tests)
Building API endpoints (see API Endpoints Skill for REST exposure)
Adding domain events (covered in CRUD Operations Skill workflow)
